_comment: Hand-picked posts. tools/refresh-instagram.mjs overwrites this file once INSTAGRAM_TOKEN is set. To swap an image by hand: drop a square JPEG in assets/ig/ and point 'image' at it. 'permalink' should be the individual post URL (instagram.com/p/XXXX) when you have it; the profile URL is a safe fallback.
